rounds.prompt: How many Haribo Goldbears gummy bears would it take to weigh as much as an average adult male grizzly bear?
rounds.source: NPS (Yellowstone): adult male grizzlies average 187 kg (413 lb) · Haribo US: 13 Goldbears per 30 g

rounds.prompt: How many drops of hot sauce are in a standard 2 oz (60 ml) bottle of Tabasco?
rounds.source: McIlhenny Co. Tabasco FAQ: a 2 oz bottle holds at least 720 drops, at 60 drops to a teaspoon

rounds.prompt: Beekeepers buy live bees by the pound. How many honeybees are in 1 pound (450 g) of bees?
rounds.source: MAAREC (University of Delaware Extension) package bees guide: each pound is about 3,500 bees
